comparison.objective: Secure a clevis pin by bending both cotter-pin legs in opposite directions.
comparison.physical_skill: Controlled plastic bending of two slender legs without harmful rebending.
comparison.success_condition: Both legs bent at least 60 degrees, hands clear, still for 1 s; specified rebending permanently fails.
comparison.reason: Permanent fastener deformation is unrelated to retaining large parts while passing smaller media through a screen. No material rubric detail is missing.
